notes: Branch 1 ends at «حدثنا أبي» (أبي = the father of محمد, a relation); branch 2 converges on يحيى بن الفياض, so همام and قتادة are written in both branches.
The variant «قال ابن المثنى قال عن الحسن» names another transmitter for the same saying; it is not a route.
Second saying: Ahmad b. Yunus says he asked Sufyan, so سفيان is the link. The later answer («اكبسه») is too short for a saying label and is not stored.
Abu Dawud's own comments (باطل, Sa'id b. al-Musayyab) have no transmitter and are left out.
